between_run_finals.note: 跨 run 终点（ΔCE_final vs ΔCPI_final）：run 间结构，含 between-run confounding；不作独立 replicate 假设

uncertainty.note: sample-level SE（~0.02）是固定模型估计精度；run-level SD 是训练层面噪声；两者不可互换；独立 training replicates 数少（≤2/family）

verdict: P1-B：单纯 conditional estimation improvement 不足以解释 SFT-induced compatibility attenuation

verdict_operationalization.rel_stable: pooled Spearman ≥ 0.5 且 run-clustered slope bootstrap CI 上限 < 0
verdict_operationalization.loo_stable: 所有 n_pairs≥10 的 leave-one-out Spearman ≥ 0.3
